thread:
maria (partnerships): FYI — AWS Marketplace wants a bundled attestation for our Dedicated offering. They specifically asked for: SOC2 report, 3rd-party pen-test summary, and a signed attestation form. Deadline: 2 weeks. Who can own the deliverable packaging?

sam (security): I can own the pen-test summary and coordinate with our vendor. Need to confirm scope: do they want full infra pen-test or just control plane + API surfaces?

maria (partnerships): They mentioned platform + marketplace integration surface. They also want confirmation about third-party hardware FIPS modules for our Private deploy option.

anjali (legal): For the signed attestation we need an approved template. I can prep the template but need an owner to confirm factual statements (S3 retention, KMS usage, VPC options).

tom (eng): I can pull the config snippets and short infra statements. Also we should include the quantization/hardware notes for the FIPS ask (hardware partner provided certs).

kelly (partner-ops): Heads-up — several SI partners asked for a copy of the SOC2 redacted summary too. We should centralize artifacts in a secure share, presigned links only, and record owners per artifact.

sam (security): Agreed on presigned S3. I propose env: s3://rwd-marketplace-artifacts/marketplace-attestations/ with one folder per partner/marketplace. Files should be PII-redacted. I can run a quick redaction checklist.

devsec-bot: Reminder: when uploading SOC2 PDFs, set bucket policy to expire links after 7 days and enable server-side encryption (SSE-KMS).

anjali (legal): Also need to ensure any pen-test reports have an NDA/redaction flag before sharing. If the vendor insists no redaction, we need to escalate for legal review.

maria (partnerships): Action items then: 1) Sam: coordinate pen-test extract + redaction checklist (owner). 2) Tom: provide infra statements + FIPS cert references. 3) Anjali: attestation template + sign-off workflow. 4) Kelly: create S3 layout and access gating for marketplace. Deadline: 2 weeks (preferred), escalate if vendor delays.

sam (security): I'll start vendor ask today and target a redacted summary within 7 business days. If vendor delays, we'll iterate with legal.

tom (eng): I'll drop a short snippet (approx 3-4 lines per item) describing KMS usage, network isolation, and hardware attestations by EOD tomorrow.

kelly (partner-ops): Creating S3 layout and IAM perms now. Will share a presign script: \n```\naws s3 presign s3://rwd-marketplace-artifacts/marketplace-attestations/1967504321/soc2-redacted.pdf --expires-in 604800\n```\n
anjali (legal): Send me the final factual statements before I finalize the attestation. I can also prepare a minimal non-disclosure appendix for pen-test attachments.

maria (partnerships): Thanks. I'll coordinate with the AWS Marketplace contact and set expectation we may ask for a 1-week extension if vendor redaction takes longer. Please update this thread with uploads or blockers. :thumbsup:

sam (security): Noted — I'll post the vendor timeline and the redacted file link here when ready.

kelly (partner-ops): Uploaded folder skeleton and sent invite to the listed owners. Link (internal): https://rwd-internal.s3.console/aws/s3/buckets/rwd-marketplace-artifacts/marketplace-attestations/1967504321/

maria (partnerships): Great, thanks everyone. If any SI/hardware partner needs an authorizing statement, ping me and I'll coordinate a short joint statement for listings.

anjali (legal): One more: for the signed attestation, do we need a notarized signature or corporate sig? Marketplace typically accepts C-level sign-off. I'll confirm requirement and update.

maria (partnerships): Perfect. Closing loop: owners assigned, timeline set. Will follow up with AWS contact for extension if needed.
